exact_statement: For every m>=2, take the actual Boolean sign F_m(z,x)=(-1)^(sum_j x_(2j-1)x_(2j))-(1-z)1_{x=0} on 2m+1 uniform bits. Set A=2^-m, d=A^2, N=2^(2m), n_plus=(N+2^m)/2, n_minus=(N-2^m)/2 and c(a,b)=((a+b)^2 ln((a+b)^2/(a^2+b^2))+(a-b)^2 ln((a-b)^2/(a^2+b^2)))/2. Then Inf_z=hat F({z})=d, I(F)=m+(2m+1)d, C_z^+=(n_plus-1)c(A-d,d)+n_minus c(A+d,d), ell_z=d^2 ln(1/d^2). Its joint paid rate obeys 2+2d[ln(1/d)-2/(1-A)]<=(C_z^++ell_z)/d<=2-2d+2d ln(1/d), is strictly greater than 2, and tends to 2 from above. At m=2 it exceeds 217/100 by a rigorous rational-log certificate. Its nonempty-row oriented erasure obeys |M_z^+/d-2m ln2|<=8*2^-m; the expensive selected query is not a universal good-coordinate obstruction. H_bits(F)/I(F)<=2+1/m, and total oriented M/I<=(1+2d)ln2; this is not an unbounded FEI-ratio family. This is a narrow stress test of the pending joint singleton budget, not a universal residual payment.

After contracting controls outside the two fixed sets, one row-independent normalized complete reference on every nonempty control subset uses at most five flat cells (four when compatible) with log-cardinality<=twice conditional mean degree.
